features: Enforces event lifecycle rules: completed events cannot be deleted and may only be archived
Archive Event is available only for events whose status is Completed, with server-side enforcement preventing bypass
Draft, Published and Cancelled non-completed events expose a permanent Delete action for test, duplicate or unwanted events
Completed events expose Archive instead of Delete in Events & Tickets
Archived events are removed from the active Events & Tickets list and remain accessible through Archived Events with Open and Restore actions
Delete and Archive actions require authenticated permissions, CSRF validation and explicit confirmation
Completed-event delete protection is enforced server-side even if a delete request is submitted manually
No manual Staging or Production deployment performed; automatic deployment status must be verified separately
